output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply * 10 ** uint256(decimals) operation can overflow if initialSupply is large, causing it to revert.

The _transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The assertion 'assert(balanceOf[_from] + balanceOf[_to] == previousBalances);' can overflow if balanceOf[_from] is large, causing it to revert.
The burnFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The _value <= allowance[_from][msg.sender] check is bypassed if _value is large, causing it to revert.
The transferFrom function allows a spender to transfer funds to an arbitrary address, which can be exploited to cause an integer overflow vulnerability in the _transfer function.
The transfer function allows anyone to transfer funds to an arbitrary address, which can be exploited to cause an integer overflow vulnerability in the _transfer function.
